text:
elaine_csm: Quick thread to lock down EBR for Northwind Financial. Core asks: 1) account health snapshot (activation + retention), 2) top renewal risks and mitigation plan, 3) enablement timeline for power users, 4) one-slide exec asks. Need owners and deadlines.

ricardo_sales: I'll own the exec asks + renewal posture slide. Plan to propose a 30-day remediation ask + 1-month usage credit. ETA Wed noon.

mira_pd: I can draft product impact + demo script (10m). Need top 3 friction scenarios from CS.

tyler_eng: I'll do a short tech appendix: SSO status and API error trend (30d). ETA Tue EOD.

elaine_csm: I'll pull activation funnel and customer feedback quotes. Also compiling support backlog items that affect adoption. ETA Tue 3pm.

infra_bot: Reminder: EBR template lives at https://redwood.app/internal/ebr-templates/northwind. Checklist: owners, due dates, proof of credit (if any), demo plan.

ricardo_sales: Action owners: exec asks -> ricardo, product/demo -> mira, infra appendix -> tyler, health + feedback -> elaine. Draft deck due Thu 4pm for Fri dry run.

mira_pd: For demo, please send 2-3 customer scenarios by Tue noon. Elaine can you share?

elaine_csm: Sending scenarios now. Also note a billing dispute from last month resolved but customer wants preventative steps documented. Will include in appendix.

tyler_eng: Quick infra snippet I'll paste into appendix: P95 latency 180ms (30d), API errors 0.05%, recent deploys had no rollback.

ricardo_sales: Posting v1 exec asks: 1) Approve usage credit, 2) Sponsor a joint finance-CS sync to reduce invoice lag, 3) Greenlight a 6-week onboarding sweep. Please comment.

mira_pd: Demo will highlight admin console and quick fix flows. Keeping it high-level for execs; technical fallback in appendix.

elaine_csm: Can someone confirm who will host the power-user enablement? I can run a 45-min session Wed next week if that works.

ricardo_sales: Wed works for us. I'll coordinate invites and stakeholders.

infra_bot: Readiness check in 48h: owners? YES. links? PARTIAL. exec asks? PARTIAL. Please update the drive with slides by Thu 4pm.

elaine_csm: I'll upload health slide by Tue 3pm and flag any blockers here. If anything changes DM me. :sparkles:
